events.title: Family Forest School at Tenafly Nature Center
events.description: A 90-minute outdoor nature adventure for kids 18 months to 3.5 years with their caregivers; the fall session runs through December 3 (see the center's site to sign up).

events.title: 1776 Fort Lee on the Palisades
events.description: A Revolutionary War anniversary program at Fort Lee Historic Park marking the 1776 events on the Palisades; good for history-curious kids.

events.title: 1776 Invasion of the Jerseys
events.location: Alpine Picnic Area, Palisades Interstate Park
events.description: A Palisades Interstate Park history program at the Alpine Picnic Area tied to the 250th anniversary of the 1776 campaign in New Jersey.

events.title: Bounce Safari Open Bounce
events.description: Walk-in open bounce sessions on the inflatables. Schedule comes from an undated Facebook post, so confirm before going.

places.name: Nickelodeon Universe Theme Park
places.description: A full indoor amusement park with record-breaking coasters, gentler junior rides and Nickelodeon character meet-and-greets, so it works year-round no matter the weather.

places.name: DreamWorks Water Park
places.description: North America's largest indoor water park, kept at a tropical 82°F all year, with big slides, a wave pool and DreamWorks characters; a Sunset Pass covers the last three hours of the day.

places.name: Big SNOW American Dream
places.description: North America's only indoor real-snow ski and snowboard slope, open year-round, with lessons, snow play and tubing packages for first-timers.

places.name: LEGOLAND Discovery Center New Jersey
places.description: An indoor LEGO playground with building zones and rides aimed at younger kids; combo tickets with SEA LIFE next door are available.

places.name: SEA LIFE New Jersey Aquarium
places.description: An indoor aquarium inside American Dream that pairs easily with LEGOLAND Discovery Center for a full rainy-day outing with little ones.

places.name: The Rink @ The Arena
places.description: An NHL-size indoor rink at American Dream with public skating sessions and Learn to Skate classes for beginners of every age.

places.name: Sesame Street Learn & Play
places.description: A Sesame Street-themed play attraction at American Dream geared to preschoolers; it is listed among the mall's current attractions.

places.name: Angry Birds Mini Golf
places.description: Indoor themed mini golf at American Dream, a lower-key add-on to a day at the parks; listed among the mall's current attractions.

places.name: The Gameroom Powered by Hasbro
places.description: A Hasbro-branded arcade and game space at American Dream, good for teens and groups; listed among the mall's current attractions and birthday venues.

places.name: Bergen County Zoo
places.price_text: Adults $6 Bergen residents / $10 non-residents; kids less
places.hours_text: 10 AM - 4:30 PM daily (last entry 4 PM), weather permitting
places.description: A small, very manageable county zoo with animals from the Americas plus a train and carousel ($3 a ride), and cheap admission for Bergen residents.

places.name: Van Saun County Park
places.hours_text: Most county parks open 7:30 AM to a half hour after sunset
places.description: One of the county's busiest parks, with big playgrounds, the zoo, a carousel, a mini train, pony rides and a dog park near the Continental Avenue entrance in River Edge.

places.name: Saddle River County Park
places.description: A 577-acre linear park linking five areas by a roughly 6-mile bike and walking path, with ponds, playgrounds, a waterfall at Dunkerhook and ice skating on ponds when conditions allow.

places.name: Wild Duck Pond (Saddle River County Park)
places.description: A favorite stop on the Saddle River path with a pond, playground, picnic areas and an off-leash dog run; ice skating is allowed when the weather cooperates.

places.name: Overpeck County Park
places.description: Bergen's 805-acre premier recreation park with a playground, five miles of walking and biking paths, a kayak launch, sports fields and an off-leash dog area.

places.name: Ramapo Valley County Reservation
places.description: Bergen's largest park at over 4,000 acres, with hilly trails, the Ramapo River, ponds and cross-country skiing in winter; great for a real hike close to home.

places.name: Riverside County Park
places.address: 315 Riverside Ave, Lyndhurst (North); 799 Riverside Ave, North Arlington (South)
places.description: An 85-acre park along the Passaic River with over 3 miles of paved paths, ball fields, a rowing center and the county's Joseph A. Carucci Jr. dog run.

places.name: Wood Dale County Park
places.description: A 118-acre northern Bergen park built around a scenic pond, with catch-and-release fishing, picnic spots and one of the county's dog runs.

places.name: Sam Nelkin County Park Dog Run
places.description: One of five official Bergen County dog runs, handy for South Bergen dog owners.

places.name: James A. McFaul Environmental Center
places.hours_text: Hours change with the seasons; closed Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Day
places.description: A county wildlife sanctuary on a former 81-acre farm with nature trails, gardens and indoor science exhibits, an easy free outing with small kids.

places.name: Campgaw Mountain Ski & Tubing
places.description: Bergen County's own small ski hill with beginner-friendly slopes, lessons and snow tubing; 2026-27 season passes and programs are on sale now.

places.name: Palisades Interstate Park (NJ Section)
places.address: Along the Hudson River cliffs, Fort Lee to Alpine
places.description: About 2,500 acres of clifftop and riverfront parkland minutes from Manhattan, with the Long Path and Shore Trail plus history programs at Fort Lee Historic Park.

places.name: Fort Lee Historic Park
places.description: A Revolutionary War site on top of the Palisades that hosts frequent history programs, lectures and reenactments.

places.name: State Line Lookout
places.description: The highest point on the Palisades cliffs, with wide Hudson River views and trailheads; a classic short scenic outing.

places.name: Flat Rock Brook Nature Center
places.description: 3.6 miles of self-guided forest trails on the Palisades ridge with a cascading stream, a natural playground and picnic area.

places.name: Tenafly Nature Center
places.description: A wooded preserve with miles of trails and Pfister's Pond, plus year-round family nature programs including toddler mornings and seasonal campfires.

places.name: The Celery Farm
places.description: A 107-acre wetland preserve with footpaths and observation platforms where over 240 bird species have been spotted, great for a quiet family walk.

places.name: Richard W. DeKorte Park
places.description: Meadowlands park with about 3.5 miles of paths and boardwalks over the marsh with big wetland views; note part of the Saw Mill Creek Trail is closed after storm damage.

places.name: Lorrimer Sanctuary
places.description: A 14-acre NJ Audubon sanctuary with a short, easy self-guided trail loop that's perfect for little legs.

places.name: Teaneck Creek Conservancy
places.description: About 1.3 miles of groomed trails through restored wetlands with outdoor eco-art installations; the site says the trails remain open.

places.name: Abma's Farm
places.description: A 90-plus-year-old family farm with a farm market and bakery plus a barnyard petting zoo with goats, alpacas, ponies and 'Bunnyville', and seasonal events like photos with Santa.

places.name: Demarest Farms
places.price_text: Petting zoo ticketed; Orchard of Lights $35-$69
places.description: A Pascack Valley farm market with a farmyard petting zoo and, in the holiday season, an Orchard of Lights and Santa photo sessions.

places.name: Catch Air Paramus
places.description: Catch Air's Paramus indoor playground for young children, a sister location to Hasbrouck Heights.

places.name: Sky Zone Allendale-Saddle River
places.description: A big trampoline park with open jump, foam pits and dodgeball, plus holiday events like a noon New Year's Eve party for kids.

places.name: Urban Air Adventure Park
places.hours_text: Sun 10 AM - 8 PM; Mon 3 PM - 8 PM (see site for other days)
places.description: A trampoline and adventure park with climbing, ninja-style courses and an all-day play option, good for burning off energy on cold days.

places.name: Xtreme Energy Active Play
places.hours_text: Tue-Thu 1 PM - 6 PM; Fri 1 PM - 8 PM; Sat-Sun 10 AM - 8 PM
places.description: Obstacle courses, trampolines, rock climbing and ninja challenges designed for kids ages 2 to 12.

places.name: Catch Air Hasbrouck Heights
places.hours_text: Sun-Wed 10 AM - 7 PM; Thu-Sat 10 AM - 8 PM
places.description: A space-themed indoor playground for young kids with walk-ins welcome; grippy socks required.

places.name: Jumpin' Jax Kids
places.hours_text: Open play Mon-Fri 10 AM - 3 PM; Sat-Sun 10 AM - 1 PM
places.description: A long-running Paramus indoor play area with soft crawling zones for babies and climbing features for older kids during open play.

places.name: Go Playland
places.address: Westfield Garden State Plaza, 1 Garden State Plaza
places.hours_text: Mon-Thu 10 AM - 9 PM; Fri-Sat 10 AM - 9:30 PM
places.description: An indoor playground inside Garden State Plaza for ages 1-12 with climbing walls, slides, ball pits, a trampoline and sensory play.

places.name: The Great Story Kids Cafe
places.address: 321 Broad Ave Ste 135 (entrance inside Super H Mart)
places.hours_text: Mon-Sat 10 AM - 7 PM; Sun 11 AM - 6 PM
places.description: A themed indoor playground with zones for imaginative play, climbing and racing, aimed at younger kids; socks required.

places.name: Paper Street Play
places.description: A boutique play space of child-sized playhouses for pretend play, capped at 10 admissions per 90-minute slot so it stays calm; reservations recommended.

places.name: Bounce Safari
places.description: Indoor inflatables and play structures known mainly for private parties, with periodic open bounce sessions for walk-ins.

places.name: BounceU Paramus
places.description: Inflatable bounce rooms near Garden State Plaza known for private parties, with scheduled open bounce sessions for kids to burn off energy.

places.name: 1 Gym 4 All
places.description: An inclusive sensory gym with swings, a trampoline and zipline in one easy-to-watch room, now at a new Waldwick location.

places.name: Humdingers
places.description: An all-in-one entertainment center with 12 boutique bowling lanes, a new 30-player laser tag arena, an interactive ValoArena, arcade and food.

places.name: Monster Mini Golf Paramus
places.hours_text: Mon, Tue, Thu 2-9 PM; Wed 12-9 PM; Fri 2-10 PM; Sat 12-10 PM; Sun 12-8 PM
places.description: An 18-hole glow-in-the-dark indoor mini golf course with monster-themed obstacles and an arcade.

places.name: Power Up Arena
places.description: A 17,000 sq ft high-tech game zone inside Garden State Plaza with gel blaster battles, free-roam VR, a glowing pixel floor and arcade games; walk-ins welcome.

places.name: NxGn Arena
places.price_text: Laser tag $40 per player per hour ($25 happy hour)
places.description: Tactical laser tag in an apocalyptic NYC-style arena plus arcade, VR and sim racing; most attractions start at age 7.

places.name: Birdies Golf
places.description: Indoor 18-hole putting course plus golf simulators that also play baseball, soccer, hockey and more, so it's fun even for non-golfers.

places.name: Paramus Mini Golf
places.description: A classic outdoor mini golf course; check its Facebook page for seasonal hours and weather closures.

places.name: Bowler City Lanes
places.description: A longtime Hackensack bowling landmark that's a go-to for rainy days and kids' birthday parties.

places.name: North Arlington Bowl
places.description: A neighborhood bowling center in South Bergen for casual family games and leagues.

places.name: Bowlero Fair Lawn
places.description: A Bowlero bowling center in Fair Lawn, good for group outings and birthdays.

places.name: Holiday Bowl
places.description: A northwest Bergen bowling alley for laid-back family games.

places.name: Wallington Lanes
places.description: A South Bergen bowling center listed in the 2026 local bowling guide.

places.name: Ice House
places.price_text: $25 online / $30 at the booth (skate rental included)
places.description: A four-rink skating complex with public skating sessions that include skate rental; helmets are strongly recommended.

places.name: GOAT Climbing Gym
places.hours_text: Mon-Fri 10 AM - 10 PM; Sat 10 AM - 8 PM; Sun 10 AM - 6 PM
places.description: A walk-in roped-climbing gym with some of the tallest walls in the area (25-60 ft), welcoming to both kids and first-timers.

places.name: The Gravity Vault Upper Saddle River
places.description: A 19,000 sq ft climbing and bouldering gym with 140+ routes, a speed wall and kids' classes, camps and parties for ages 5 and up.

places.name: Aviation Hall of Fame & Museum of New Jersey
places.description: A museum at Teterboro Airport with historic aircraft, engines and space gear that plane-loving kids will enjoy.

places.name: Meadowlands Museum
places.description: A small local history museum in an old house, with a collection of antique toys and children's games.

places.name: Historic New Bridge Landing
places.description: Revolutionary War-era Bergen Dutch sandstone houses along the Hackensack River with a self-guided walking tour and Bergen County Historical Society programs.

places.name: The Hermitage
places.description: A National Historic Landmark house museum open year-round for tours, gardens and family programs.

places.name: Westfield Garden State Plaza
places.description: New Jersey's flagship mall, with kid-friendly stops like Go Playland and Power Up Arena that make it a solid rainy-day base.

places.name: American Dream
places.description: A mega-mall with Nickelodeon Universe, DreamWorks Water Park, Big SNOW, SEA LIFE, LEGOLAND Discovery Center and dozens of smaller attractions under one roof.

places.name: Ramsey Free Public Library Children's Room
places.description: A children's room with monthly storytimes, crafts and performances, plus take-home story time kits and borrowable sensory kits.

places.name: Leonia Public Library Children's Room
places.description: The lower-level children's room has a toddler play area, free coloring pages and plenty of books, an easy free rainy-day stop.
